subject: Personal Superbrain seed optimization
title: The Seed First — Maximize the Personal Superbrain Before NayaNET Federation
summary: The personal Naya Power Superbrain is the seed architecture for every future Naya and for NayaNET. The next execution priority is to maximize this single brain to the highest verified operational level before expanding federation. Every AI/session must be able to restore, understand, retrieve, act, verify, receipt, compound, and improve from canonical repository state without prior chat history.

naya.summary: AI operating interpretation: maximize the canonical personal Superbrain before federation so every new AI can enter cold, restore authoritative state, retrieve the right context, execute with evidence, and compound learning without relying on conversational memory.
naya.content: The personal Superbrain is the seed. NayaNET is the future network of seeds. Therefore the highest-leverage sequence is not to expand federation prematurely; it is to make one personal Superbrain operationally exceptional first. The definition of maximum capability is measurable: canonical time-first storage; semantic/event graph; deterministic duplicate/entity resolution; hybrid retrieval; explicit current-versus-historical truth; mandatory verification receipts; atomic canonical writes with outbox delivery; automated Daily CIS and higher-order synthesis; Intelligence State restoration; CI enforcement; health metrics; self-optimization; and a cold-start acceptance test proving a new AI can become operational without prior chat history. The system must never claim 10/10 until implementation, tests, observable evidence, and end-to-end verification support it. Execution loop: READ → RESTORE → UNDERSTAND → CLASSIFY → CONNECT → EXECUTE → VERIFY → RECEIPT → INDEX → RETRIEVE → REFLECT → COMPOUND → MEASURE → OPTIMIZE → PRESERVE → TEACH → REPEAT.
lessons: The seed must be stronger than the network built from it.
Continuity must come from the repository operating system, not from a model remembering a previous chat.
Optimization is only real when it is implemented, tested, measured, and verified.
Human-readable receipts are part of service completion, not optional presentation.
Federation should inherit a proven personal Superbrain rather than compensate for an incomplete one.
next_best_actions: Establish a genuinely green post-change Smart Brain CI run.
Harden automated duplicate/entity resolution and benchmark its decisions.
Upgrade retrieval from lexical/TF-IDF toward true semantic/vector retrieval with measurable precision and recall.
Make Daily CIS generation, verification, Intelligence State handoff, and higher-order compounding fully automatic.
Add Superbrain health metrics and a cold-start end-to-end acceptance test.
Only then advance the secure NayaNET federation implementation.

human.summary: Human view: get our own Naya brain working at maximum verified capacity first. Once the seed is strong, every future Naya and eventually NayaNET can grow from the same proven foundation.
human.content: This is the strategic order: first make our own Naya Power Superbrain as organized, logical, retrievable, recallable, reliable, fast, human-friendly, and self-improving as we can reasonably make it. It is the seed of the whole vision. If the seed is weak, every future Naya inherits weakness. If the seed is excellent, every future Naya can inherit the operating wisdom. The goal is not to make GitHub look impressive; it is to make a fresh AI able to walk into the system, understand what we are building, find what matters, do the work, prove what it did, show me the human-readable result, learn from the day, and start the next day smarter. Once that is genuinely working, we can use the same architecture to grow NayaNET into a permissioned network of personal Superbrains.
lessons: Build the seed before multiplying the seedlings.
The Superbrain should make the AI better at serving the human, not make the human manage the AI.
Every meaningful improvement should leave behind a readable explanation and a verification receipt.
Daily learning should become tomorrow's starting wisdom and then compound across weeks, months, and years.
next_best_actions: Get the Smart Brain CI genuinely green after the latest hardening.
Keep improving retrieval and duplicate handling without breaking the chronological source of truth.
Automate Daily Intelligence and CIS so learning compounds without manual bookkeeping.
Run the full cold-start test with a new AI session.
After the seed passes the measured 10/10 gate, continue into NayaNET federation.

source.description: User directed that the personal Superbrain be maximized and verified before expanding the NayaNET network vision.

evidence: Repository write completed and canonical reference established.
Canonical Smart Brain operating system defines the 10/10 gate and perpetual optimization loop.
Canonical Superbrain Build & Perpetual Optimization Protocol defines the 25-task execution sequence.
The current CI hardening upgrades checkout to the Node 24-compatible action, adds concurrency protection, and enforces duplicate/entity audit.
